newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela to sign 17 oil contracts Tuesday - PDVSA.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela to sign 17 oil contracts Tuesday - PDVSA.

text.p: Venezuela's state-owned oil company Petroleos de Venezuela (PDVSA) plans on Tuesday to sign 17 new oil and gas production contracts with private companies, a company spokeswoman said Monday.

Venezuelan and international oil companies paid over $2 billion for the 20-year contracts in a hotly contested bidding round last month. They allow the private partner to reactivate ageing or abandoned oilfields in return for a share of the profits.

PDVSA considered the 17 areas too marginal to merit any of its own investment, but oil companies jumped at the chance to buy proven oil reserves with relatively low risk. Independent UK oil company Lasmo, for example, paid $453 million for just one of the contracts.
It was the third such auction of oil production contracts, a key plank in Venezuela's strategy to liberalise its oil industry after 20 years of state control.
